summary: Iran conducted attacks on commercial ships in the Gulf region, prompting US military strikes on Iranian military sites. Hamas commanders were killed in an Israeli airstrike in northern Gaza. Israeli settlers entered Lebanon before being returned by the IDF. (Source: @New_security8200/202608) (Source: @manniefabian/58788) (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/377499)
key_points: Iran targeted seven commercial ships in the Gulf, killing ten civilians and injuring others, according to US Central Command. (Source: @VahidOnline/77084)
Israeli airstrikes in northern Gaza killed a Hamas commander and six others, including operatives from multiple battalions. (Source: @manniefabian/58788)
Israeli settlers crossed into Lebanon near Ghajar before being escorted back by the IDF, linked to a religious Zionist group. (Source: @manniefabian/58787)
Kuwait intercepted one ballistic missile, five cruise missiles, and 33 drones, injuring four military personnel. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4992)
US forces struck Iranian military sites near the Strait of Hormuz, targeting missile and drone capabilities. (Source: @VahidOnline/77097)
Iranian attacks on Jordan were reported, with claims of weakening Israel's regional position. (Source: @kianmeli1/89127)
Explosions were reported in Iranian cities including Bushehr and Ahvaz, amid ongoing military tensions. (Source: @VahidOnline/77079)

The targeting of civilian vessels and infrastructure raises risks of broader conflict. Israeli operations in Gaza and border incidents with Lebanon suggest ongoing low-intensity warfare.
